resolvedRequirements: Build a complete modern Kanban Task Board web application using React with TypeScript and Vite
Kanban board with columns: To Do, In Progress, Review, Done
Ability to create, edit, delete, and move tasks across columns
Task priority badges (Low, Medium, High, Urgent) and tags/labels
Search input and filter by priority/column
Metrics summary dashboard cards showing total tasks, completion percentage, and tasks by priority
LocalStorage persistence so tasks are preserved on page reload
Interactive UI with modal dialogs for task details and creation
planSummary:
PROJECT CLASSIFICATION: INTERACTIVE_FRONTEND
ARCHITECTURE: Client-side Single Page Application (SPA) built with React and Vite. State management will be handled via React Context API combined with a custom hook for LocalStorage synchronization. The UI will be component-driven, utilizing a modern drag-and-drop library for board interactions, and Tailwind CSS for responsive, themeable styling.
FEATURES:
- Four-column Kanban board (To Do, In Progress, Review, Done)
- Task CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete)
- Drag-and-drop task movement between columns
- Task priority assignment (Low, Medium, High, Urgent) with visual badges
- Custom tags/labels for tasks
- Real-time search input and priority/column filtering
- Metrics dashboard displaying total tasks, completion percentage, and priority distribution
- Persistent state using browser LocalStorage
- System-aware Dark/Light theme toggle
- Interactive modal dialogs for task creation and detailed viewing
USER FLOWS:
- Initial Load: User opens the app, state is hydrated from LocalStorage, and the dashboard/board is rendered.
- Task Creation: User clicks 'Add Task', a modal opens, user fills in title, description, priority, and tags, then saves. The task appears in the 'To Do' column.
- Task Management: User drags a task from 'To Do' to 'In Progress'. The metrics dashboard instantly updates to reflect the new state.
- Task Completion: User drags a task to 'Done'. The completion percentage metric increases.
- Search and Filter: User types in the search bar or selects a priority filter; the board instantly hides non-matching tasks.
- Theming: User clicks the theme toggle icon; the application instantly switches between dark and light color palettes.
DATA MODEL:
type Priority = 'Low' | 'Medium' | 'High' | 'Urgent'; type Status = 'To Do' | 'In Progress' | 'Review' | 'Done'; interface Task { id: string; title: string; description: string; status: Status; priority: Priority; tags: string[]; createdAt: number; } interface
